detail.longDescription: Troubleshooting common Android Wi-Fi tethering failures. If you run into the "mobile data active, but hotspot has no throughput" state, the root cause is often your APN type missing the DUN (dial-up networking) protocol attribute, which carriers use to route non-handset traffic.
